name: pickup_set_variant_from_terrain
description: Pickup::SetVariantFromTerrain clears the active variant tag, samples the pickup terrain below a position, chooses a terrain candidate, and applies either the world-child node type, the candidate variant tag, or the 255 fallback to the pickup node and display instance entries.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup terrain/spawn source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e330 validates clearing g_VariantTag_Current/g_Variant_CurrentTag, BuildPickCandidateListBelowPoint with g_Pickup_SceneNode and maxY 500.0, SelectProbeSampleHeightFromCandidates with maxRiseWindow 0.5 and preferAttachmentSlot1 1, world-child nodeType preference, candidate variant-tag fallback, and 255 fallback when no candidates exist.
The native pickup leaf smoke verifies world-child nodeType selection, candidate variant-tag fallback, no-candidate fallback, and display-instance SetVariantTagIfUnset side effects.
